therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: peripheral blood stem cell transplantation vs bone marrow transplantation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: hematopoietic reconstitution and immune system restoration
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: individuals with hematologic cancers requiring allogeneic transplantation

results.effect_size: 51% vs 46% two-year overall survival (PBSC vs BM)
results.target_engagement_evidence: neutrophil engraftment 97% vs 87%, platelet engraftment improved with PBSC
biomarker_changes: neutrophil engraftment at day 28: 97% PBSC vs 87% BM
subgroup_findings: graft failure lower with PBSC: 3% vs 9%
chronic GVHD higher with PBSC: 53% vs 41%
extensive chronic GVHD higher with PBSC: 48% vs 32%
relapse rates similar: 27.5% PBSC vs 28.9% BM
safety_signals: various grade III-V adverse events distributed across both arms
serious adverse events including deaths, MI, blindness
